def programme_authoring_module_rows(
    programme,
    config=None,
    *,
    clean_str,
    normalise,
    programme_config_identity,
    programme_deleted_row,
    programme_identifier_looks_exact,
    row_has_deleted_at,
    safe_module_index_rows
):
    programme_ids = {
        clean_str(programme.get('id')),
        clean_str(programme.get('sourceId')),
        clean_str(programme_config_identity(config)),
    }
    programme_ids = {value for value in programme_ids if value}
    programme_names = {normalise(programme.get('name')), normalise((config or {}).get('name'))}
    programme_names = {value for value in programme_names if value}
    rows = []
    # The shared index projection: callers read ids, names and schedule fields,
    # never ksb_remap_report.
    for row in safe_module_index_rows():
        if row_has_deleted_at(row) or programme_deleted_row(row):
            continue
        row_programme_id = clean_str(row.get('programme_id'))
        row_programme_name = normalise(row.get('programme_name'))
        if row_programme_id and row_programme_id in programme_ids:
            rows.append(row)
            continue
        # A module that names another programme by id is that programme's, even
        # while it still carries a name this one answers to. Two programmes may
        # share a name, and a rename that has not reached the children leaves
        # them holding the old one -- which is how this programme's page came to
        # list another programme's modules.
        if row_programme_id and programme_identifier_looks_exact(row_programme_id):
            continue
        if row_programme_name and row_programme_name in programme_names:
            rows.append(row)
    return rows

def programme_authoring_modules(
    programme,
    config=None,
    *,
    module_rows=None,
    child_rows=None,
    CATALOGUE_SUMMARY_COMPONENT_COLUMNS,
    clean_str,
    curriculum_module_from_authoring_payload,
    format_date,
    get_authoring_structure_payloads,
    programme_authoring_module_rows
):
    rows = programme_authoring_module_rows(programme, config) if module_rows is None else module_rows
    modules = []
    # One batched read for the whole programme. The per-module reader issues seven
    # queries each, so a 122-module programme spent 854 round trips (~105s) here.
    # get_authoring_structure_payloads() returns the identical payload in seven
    # queries total -- the two are compared field by field before this swap.
    payloads_by_id = get_authoring_structure_payloads(
        [clean_str(row.get('module_catalogue_id')) for row in rows],
        component_columns=CATALOGUE_SUMMARY_COMPONENT_COLUMNS,
        **({'child_rows': child_rows} if child_rows is not None else {}),
    )
    for row in rows:
        module_id = clean_str(row.get('module_catalogue_id'))
        payload = payloads_by_id.get(module_id) if module_id else None
        if payload:
            modules.append(curriculum_module_from_authoring_payload(payload))
        else:
            modules.append(curriculum_module_from_authoring_payload({
                'moduleCatalogueId': module_id,
                'title': row.get('title') or '',
                'programmeId': row.get('programme_id') or '',
                'programmeName': row.get('programme_name') or '',
                'cohortId': row.get('cohort_id') or '',
                'cohort': row.get('cohort_name') or '',
                'groupId': row.get('group_id') or '',
                'group': row.get('group_name') or '',
                'sessionsNumber': row.get('sessions_number') or 0,
                'startDate': format_date(row.get('start_date')),
                'endDate': format_date(row.get('end_date')),
                'weekDays': row.get('session_week_day') or '',
                'startTime': row.get('session_start_time') or '',
                'endTime': row.get('session_end_time') or '',
                'tutor': row.get('tutor_name') or '',
                'description': row.get('description') or '',
            }))
    return modules

def programme_config_modules(
    config,
    *,
    clean_str,
    curriculum_module_from_authoring_payload,
    get_authoring_structure_payload,
    programme_config_json_list
):
    modules = []
    for item in programme_config_json_list(config, 'modules'):
        if isinstance(item, dict):
            modules.append(curriculum_module_from_authoring_payload(item))
            continue
        module_id = clean_str(item)
        payload = get_authoring_structure_payload(module_id) if module_id else None
        if payload:
            modules.append(curriculum_module_from_authoring_payload(payload))
    return modules

def enrich_curriculum_modules_with_authoring_details(
    modules,
    *,
    child_rows=None,
    CATALOGUE_SUMMARY_COMPONENT_COLUMNS,
    clean_str,
    get_authoring_structure_payloads,
    meaningful_session_names,
    unique
):
    module_ids = unique([
        clean_str(module.get('moduleCatalogueId') or module.get('catalogueId') or module.get('moduleId') or module.get('structureId'))
        for module in modules or []
        if clean_str(module.get('moduleCatalogueId') or module.get('catalogueId') or module.get('moduleId') or module.get('structureId'))
    ])
    if not module_ids:
        return modules
    authoring_payloads = get_authoring_structure_payloads(
        module_ids,
        include_staff=False,
        include_quality=False,
        include_extra=False,
        component_columns=CATALOGUE_SUMMARY_COMPONENT_COLUMNS,
        **({'child_rows': child_rows} if child_rows is not None else {}),
    )
    enriched = []
    for module in modules or []:
        module_id = clean_str(module.get('moduleCatalogueId') or module.get('catalogueId') or module.get('moduleId') or module.get('structureId'))
        authoring = authoring_payloads.get(module_id)
        if not authoring:
            enriched.append(module)
            continue
        delivery_metadata = {
            **(module.get('deliveryMetadata') if isinstance(module.get('deliveryMetadata'), dict) else {}),
            **(authoring.get('deliveryMetadata') if isinstance(authoring.get('deliveryMetadata'), dict) else {}),
        }
        enriched.append({
            **module,
            'moduleCatalogueId': authoring.get('catalogueId') or module.get('moduleCatalogueId') or module_id,
            'catalogueId': authoring.get('catalogueId') or module.get('catalogueId') or module_id,
            'structureId': authoring.get('catalogueId') or module.get('structureId') or module_id,
            'name': authoring.get('title') or module.get('name'),
            'notes': authoring.get('description') if authoring.get('description') is not None else module.get('notes'),
            'coverImage': authoring.get('coverImage') or module.get('coverImage') or '',
            'startDate': authoring.get('startDate') or module.get('startDate'),
            'endDate': authoring.get('endDate') or module.get('endDate'),
            'sessionsNumber': authoring.get('sessionsNumber') or module.get('sessionsNumber'),
            'weeklySchedule': authoring.get('weeklySchedule') or [],
            'scheduleMode': authoring.get('scheduleMode') or 'group',
            'sessionHolidays': authoring.get('sessionHolidays') or [],
            'calendarPolicy': authoring.get('calendarPolicy'),
            'weekStartsOn': authoring.get('weekStartsOn'),
            'deliveryWeeks': authoring.get('deliveryWeeks'),
            'weekDays': authoring.get('weekDays') or module.get('weekDays') or '',
            'startTime': authoring.get('startTime') or module.get('startTime') or '',
            'endTime': authoring.get('endTime') or module.get('endTime') or '',
            'weeks': authoring.get('weeks') or module.get('weeks'),
            'weekStructure': authoring.get('weekStructure') or module.get('weekStructure') or [],
            'sessionNames': meaningful_session_names(authoring.get('sessionNames')) or module.get('sessionNames') or [],
            'moduleKsbMappings': authoring.get('moduleKsbMappings') or module.get('moduleKsbMappings') or [],
            'ksbCodes': authoring.get('ksbCodes') or module.get('ksbCodes') or [],
            'deliveryMetadata': delivery_metadata,
        })
    return enriched

def programme_workspace_module_candidates(
    modules,
    programme,
    config,
    *,
    PROGRAMME_MODULE_IDENTITY_FIELDS,
    clean_str,
    component_text_cancels,
    enrich_curriculum_modules_with_authoring_details,
    logger,
    programme_authoring_module_rows,
    programme_authoring_modules,
    programme_config_json_list,
    programme_config_modules,
    programme_structure_child_rows,
):
    """Both representations of each module, for the workspace view's selection.

    Both builders share their raw child rows, not their differently-shaped
    payloads, so the chosen module and every schedule/count stay exactly as
    before. The workspace sends a week outline, so component text never leaves
    this build; it is read only when it could change which representation of a
    module wins (see component_text_cancels). Config-stored modules carry their
    own text, so a programme with any keeps the full read.
    """
    authoring_rows = programme_authoring_module_rows(programme, config)
    child_module_ids = [
        *[clean_str(module.get('moduleCatalogueId') or module.get('catalogueId') or module.get('moduleId') or module.get('structureId')) for module in modules],
        *[clean_str(row.get('module_catalogue_id')) for row in authoring_rows],
    ]

    def module_candidates(child_rows):
        return [
            *enrich_curriculum_modules_with_authoring_details(modules, child_rows=child_rows),
            *programme_authoring_modules(programme, config, module_rows=authoring_rows, child_rows=child_rows),
            *programme_config_modules(config),
        ]

    if not programme_config_json_list(config, 'modules'):
        candidates = module_candidates(programme_structure_child_rows(child_module_ids, component_text=False))
        if component_text_cancels(candidates, PROGRAMME_MODULE_IDENTITY_FIELDS):
            return candidates
        logger.info('Programme workspace modules: component text decides a selection; reading it.')
    return module_candidates(programme_structure_child_rows(child_module_ids))

def _build_curriculum_programme_tree_detail_payload(
    identifier,
    visibility,
    include_stats=True,
    include_components=True,
    include_tree=True,
    include_week_components=True,
    section=None,
    *,
    workspace_view=False,
    CURRICULUM_SCHEMA,
    PROGRAMME_MODULE_IDENTITY_FIELDS,
    build_cohorts_and_groups,
    build_modules,
    build_programmes,
    read_programme_sessions,
    clean_str,
    component_builder_rows,
    enrich_curriculum_modules_with_authoring_details,
    find_programme,
    get_cached_curriculum_rows,
    is_operational_training_row,
    matches_curriculum_identifier,
    module_belongs_to_group,
    module_rows_with_week_outline,
    normalise_programme_config_cohort,
    normalise_programme_config_group,
    program_config_by_id,
    programme_authoring_modules,
    programme_config_for_programme,
    programme_config_identity,
    programme_config_json_list,
    programme_config_modules,
    programme_identity,
    programme_workspace_module_candidates,
    repair_curriculum_parent_links,
    slugify,
    unique,
    unique_curriculum_items,
):
    # The process-wide rows cache the list payloads share (epoch-checked, 60s
    # TTL) rather than a fresh read of every table: opening a programme straight
    # after the programme list no longer reads the same rows a second time.
    # Nothing below mutates them -- the builders only read rows and emit new
    # dicts, exactly as the list payload relies on.
    curriculum_rows = get_cached_curriculum_rows(compact=True)
    training_rows = curriculum_rows['training'] if visibility == 'all' else [
        row for row in curriculum_rows['training']
        if is_operational_training_row(row)
    ]
    ksb_profiles = curriculum_rows['ksb_profiles'] if visibility == 'all' else [
        profile for profile in curriculum_rows['ksb_profiles']
        if profile.get('is_active')
    ]
    # build_programmes() computes ksbMapped/learner-progress only for the ids it
    # is given, and here only one programme is ever returned. The first pass
    # skips every programme's stats (cheap: no extra reads) just to resolve which
    # one this identifier means, using the
    # same matching find_programme always applies; the second pass computes the
    # real numbers only for that resolved programme. See _programme_ksb_stats.
    #
    # The modules section answers with modules and sessions alone. The
    # programme's learner and structure counts are never part of it, and
    # find_programme() matches on id, sourceId and name only, so it skips the
    # learner tally and the whole-table cohort/group/module/week count reads.
    modules_section = section == 'modules'
    cheap_programmes = build_programmes(
        training_rows,
        curriculum_rows['program_configs'],
        ksb_profiles,
        include_config_only=visibility == 'all',
        only_stats_for_ids=frozenset(),
        **({'include_learner_counts': False, 'include_structure_counts': False} if modules_section else {}),
    )
    resolved_programme = find_programme({'programmes': cheap_programmes}, identifier)
    if not resolved_programme:
        return None
    # Without stats the second pass is the first pass again -- the same call
    # with the same arguments -- so its result is reused instead of rebuilt.
    programmes = build_programmes(
        training_rows,
        curriculum_rows['program_configs'],
        ksb_profiles,
        include_config_only=visibility == 'all',
        only_stats_for_ids={clean_str(resolved_programme.get('sourceId'))},
    ) if include_stats else cheap_programmes
    programme = find_programme({'programmes': programmes}, identifier)
    if not programme:
        return None
    repair_curriculum_parent_links(
        clean_str(programme.get('id') or programme.get('sourceId')), allow_writes=False
    )

    program_configs = curriculum_rows['program_configs']
    config = programme_config_for_programme(program_configs, programme)
    configs_by_id = program_config_by_id(program_configs)
    programme_training_rows = [
        row for row in training_rows
        if (
            clean_str(programme_identity(row, configs_by_id)['sourceId']) == clean_str(programme.get('sourceId'))
            or clean_str(programme_identity(row, configs_by_id)['name']) == clean_str(programme.get('name'))
        )
    ]
    # ``build_cohorts_and_groups`` intentionally reads the normalized tables as
    # its source of truth and therefore returns rows for every programme.  A
    # detail response must scope those rows again; otherwise opening one
    # programme can expose unrelated cohorts/groups and inflate every UI count.
    config_cohort_items = [item for item in programme_config_json_list(config, 'cohorts') if isinstance(item, dict)]
    all_cohorts, all_groups = build_cohorts_and_groups(
        programme_training_rows,
        program_configs,
        include_archived=visibility == 'all',
        # The modules section reads its cohorts for their holidays alone. Their
        # learner counts reach it only through unique_curriculum_items' richness
        # when a config-stored cohort shares an id, so they are skipped only
        # when the config stores none.
        **({'include_learner_counts': False} if modules_section and not config_cohort_items else {}),
    )
    programme_ids = [value for value in unique([
        programme.get('id'),
        programme.get('sourceId'),
        programme_config_identity(config),
        f'program-{slugify(programme.get("sourceId"))}',
    ]) if clean_str(value)]
    programme_names = [value for value in unique([programme.get('name')]) if clean_str(value)]

    known_programme_ids = {
        programme_config_identity(item)
        for item in program_configs
        if programme_config_identity(item)
    }

    def belongs_to_selected_programme(item):
        item_programme_id = clean_str(item.get('programmeId'))
        if any(matches_curriculum_identifier(item_programme_id, candidate) for candidate in programme_ids):
            return True
        if item_programme_id in known_programme_ids:
            return False
        return any(matches_curriculum_identifier(item.get('programme'), candidate) for candidate in programme_names)

    config_cohorts = [
        normalise_programme_config_cohort(item, programme)
        for item in programme_config_json_list(config, 'cohorts')
        if isinstance(item, dict)
    ]
    config_groups = [
        normalise_programme_config_group(item, programme)
        for item in programme_config_json_list(config, 'groups')
        if isinstance(item, dict)
    ]
    config_week_templates = [
        item for item in programme_config_json_list(config, 'week_templates')
        if isinstance(item, dict)
    ]

    cohorts = unique_curriculum_items(
        [cohort for cohort in all_cohorts if belongs_to_selected_programme(cohort)] + config_cohorts,
        ['id', 'cohortId', 'cohort_id'],
    )
    cohort_ids = {cohort.get('id') for cohort in cohorts if cohort.get('id')}
    groups = unique_curriculum_items([
        group for group in all_groups
        if group.get('cohortId') in cohort_ids and belongs_to_selected_programme(group)
    ] + config_groups, ['id', 'groupId', 'group_id'])
    group_ids = {group.get('id') for group in groups if group.get('id')}
    if section == 'shell':
        return {
            'schema': CURRICULUM_SCHEMA,
            'programme': programme,
            'flat': {
                'cohorts': cohorts,
                'groups': groups,
                'groupIds': sorted(group_ids, key=str),
                'weekTemplates': config_week_templates,
            },
        }

    modules = build_modules(
        curriculum_rows['modules'],
        programme_training_rows,
        program_configs,
        include_unused=False,
    )
    # Both representations participate in the existing richness-based selection.
    if workspace_view:
        candidates = programme_workspace_module_candidates(modules, programme, config)
    else:
        candidates = [
            *enrich_curriculum_modules_with_authoring_details(modules),
            *programme_authoring_modules(programme, config),
            *programme_config_modules(config),
        ]
    modules = unique_curriculum_items(candidates, PROGRAMME_MODULE_IDENTITY_FIELDS)
    # Resolve the canonical programme first, then read only its authored sessions.
    sessions = read_programme_sessions(programme, visibility)
    module_catalogue_ids = unique([
        module.get('moduleCatalogueId')
        or module.get('catalogueId')
        or module.get('moduleId')
        or module.get('id')
        for module in modules
        if (
            module.get('moduleCatalogueId')
            or module.get('catalogueId')
            or module.get('moduleId')
            or module.get('id')
        )
    ])
    components = component_builder_rows(module_catalogue_ids) if include_components else None
    # After every count above is derived from the full structure: the outline
    # changes what is sent, never what is computed.
    if not include_week_components:
        modules = module_rows_with_week_outline(modules)
    if section == 'modules':
        return {
            'schema': CURRICULUM_SCHEMA,
            'flat': {
                'modules': modules,
                'sessions': sessions,
            },
        }

    nested_cohorts = []
    for cohort in (cohorts if include_tree else []):
        nested_groups = []
        for group in [item for item in groups if item.get('cohortId') == cohort['id']]:
            group_modules = [
                module for module in modules
                if module_belongs_to_group(module, group)
            ]
            nested_groups.append({**group, 'modules': group_modules})
        nested_cohorts.append({**cohort, 'groups': nested_groups})

    return {
        'schema': CURRICULUM_SCHEMA,
        'programme': programme,
        **({'cohorts': nested_cohorts} if include_tree else {}),
        'flat': {
            'cohorts': cohorts,
            'groups': groups,
            # Sorted: a set's iteration order differs between worker processes,
            # which gave the same document a different ETag on each worker.
            'groupIds': sorted(group_ids, key=str),
            'modules': modules,
            'sessions': sessions,
            **({'components': components} if include_components else {}),
            'weekTemplates': config_week_templates,
        },
    }

def component_text_cancels(items, identity_fields):
    """Whether unique_curriculum_items() decides the same with or without text.

    Its richness is ``len(json.dumps(item))`` plus counts that do not involve
    text. Where every candidate sharing a key carries the very same components
    -- the same rows, built by the same code -- each component's text adds the
    same length to both sides of every comparison it makes, so blanking it
    changes no decision. Any key whose candidates carry different components,
    or components not built from the shared rows, makes this False, and the
    caller reads the text after all. Keys mirror unique_curriculum_items(); an
    item it gives a row key of its own is never compared.
    """
    from . import views

    layouts = defaultdict(set)
    for item in items or []:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        key = next((views.clean_str(item.get(field)) for field in identity_fields if views.clean_str(item.get(field))), '')
        if not key:
            key = views.normalise(item.get('name') or item.get('title'))
        if not key:
            continue
        layout = _component_layout(item)
        if layout is None:
            return False
        layouts[key].add(layout)
    return all(len(found) == 1 for found in layouts.values())
